data.welcomeMessage:
Billing & payments

• Upgrade or change your plan from Dashboard → Billing.
• Invoices are usually sent to your account email.
• If a payment fails, wait 10 to 15 minutes and try again. If it still fails, please Talk to an agent.

For refunds or billing disputes, please Talk to an agent so we can review the payment details safely.

data.welcomeMessage:
Technical help

Templates
• Pending means Meta is still reviewing your message. Please wait. Do not submit the same template again and again.
• Rejected usually means the category or wording needs a fix. Open Templates, read Meta’s note, correct the text or category, then submit a fresh version.
• Tip: Promotions need the Marketing category. Order updates and account alerts usually use Utility. OTPs use Authentication.

Messages not delivering
• First check that your WhatsApp Number shows Connected under Integration.
• Outside the 24 hour customer chat window, free form replies are blocked. Use an approved template instead.
• If the contact sent STOP, do not keep sending marketing or automation messages to that number.
• Also check Inbox delivery status and wallet balance.

Connecting your WhatsApp Number
• During setup you may see a scan code or Meta signup screen. That is how you link your WhatsApp Business Number to WapApp.
• Refresh Integration, try Chrome or an Incognito window, and allow pop ups for Meta login.
• Use an account that has admin access on the Meta Business / WhatsApp Business Account.

Share the exact error text or a screenshot so we can help faster. You can also Ask AI or Talk to an agent.

data.welcomeMessage:
Account & WhatsApp Number

• Check your email (and spam folder) for login OTPs.
• If a WhatsApp Number shows disconnected, reconnect it under Integration.
• Team member access is managed in Team settings.

For account ownership changes or transfers, please Talk to an agent.
